title: Papyrus Compile Window
content: The Papyrus Compile Window is used for batch compilation of Script Files. The window can be found under the Creation Kit title bar menu, Gameplay -> Compile Papyrus Script.... Editor Window: File:Papyrus Compile Window.png - Script File: The name of the Script File. Checkbox: The Script File is selected when checked. - Check All Checked-Out: - Check All: - Uncheck All: - Compile: - Cancel: See Also: - Papyrus - Script File - Papyrus Manager Window - Editor Interface
